source_families.limitation: One US-funded outlet outside Iran: a single origin. Its search matches all query words, so each query sees a thin slice; the result sets for winter 1404 (2025-26) and for 1405 were empty for every energy-closure or scheduled-cut wording tried.

source_families.family: Wikipedia, discovery only (never cited)
source_families.method: fa.wikipedia.org address guessed for the energy-imbalance article
source_families.limitation: The English article was used for discovery in the first pass.

source_families.family: Israel National Cyber Directorate and ministries (official statements)
source_families.method: Direct fetch of gov.il attempted; official statements read as relayed by Bloomberg (via Insurance Journal, 25 Mar 2026), AP (via SecurityWeek, 30 Mar 2026), Jerusalem Post, JNS and Iran International.
source_families.limitation: Primary Hebrew-language statements were not opened. Negative finding worth keeping: on 24 March 2026 the directorate's director-general told reporters that Iran-linked actors had not infiltrated or disrupted critical infrastructure such as energy grids, banks or hospitals during the 2026 war, while data had been destroyed at more than 50 small companies and about 50 public cameras had been accessed. No 2026 Israeli critical-service cyber disruption was therefore filed.

source_families.method: Direct fetch of the topic index, then of the relevant articles.
source_families.limitation: The Times of Israel index loads older items through a 'Load more' control that a direct fetch cannot follow, so 2022 to early 2026 was not enumerated there.

source_families.family: CISA advisories and alerts index
source_families.method: direct fetch of the index with the advisory-type filter and with the site's own full-text search ('operational disruption')
source_families.limitation: The index is dominated by known-exploited-vulnerability alerts and the type filter does not isolate joint advisories; at 10 items per page a full pass is about 500 fetches. AA25-343A describes effects only in general terms (temporary loss of view, manual intervention, some physical damage) and names no US or Canadian victim, so it yields attribution context, not a new record. AA23-335A and the 2024 water fact sheets were not opened (water lane).
